app.name: HeavyScope
app.tagline: Multi-quota monitor for SuperGrok Heavy + Cursor Ultra

dashboard.title: Quota overview
dashboard.subtitle: Local-first. Data lives in a browser SQLite database.
dashboard.empty: No pools yet. Add one to get started.

live.cursorHint: Paste WorkosCursorSessionToken from cursor.com cookies after you log in. Stored only in the local settings table. Never logged.
live.cursorVscdbFailed: Could not read Cursor state.vscdb. This helper only works on a real Mac desktop build.
live.grokHint: Paste a grok.com session cookie and/or a Bearer token (xAI OAuth / grok.com session). Stored only on this device.
live.grokCookiePlaceholder: Paste the Cookie header or session pair…
live.tokenStored: Token stored on this device. Paste a new value to replace it.

form.name: Name
form.confirmDelete: Delete this pool and its usage records?

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Takes effect immediately. Stored in localStorage and the local settings table.
settings.themeHint: Dark is the default panel look. Light uses a white surface. System follows the OS. Stored in localStorage and the local settings table.
settings.aboutBody: HeavyScope is a local multi-quota panel for SuperGrok Heavy and Cursor Ultra. The web app and the Tauri 2 macOS menu-bar accessory share this UI.
settings.dataHint: SQLite runs in the browser via sql.js and is persisted to localStorage.
settings.resetDataHint: Deletes every pool and usage record, then reseeds the four preset pools.
settings.backupExportHint: Download pools, usage records, and settings as heavyscope-backup.json. This is table JSON, not a sql.js wasm binary.
settings.backupCopied: Copied backup JSON to the clipboard.
settings.backupCopyFailed: Could not copy backup JSON to the clipboard.
settings.backupImportHint: Merge is the default: pools upsert by id, unknown usage records are inserted, duplicate ids are skipped, and settings keys are merged. Language is left alone unless the file includes it.
settings.backupPasted: Pasted backup JSON from the clipboard.
settings.backupPasteFailed: Could not read backup JSON from the clipboard.
settings.backupConfirm: Apply this backup to the local database?
settings.backupConfirmReplace: This will delete every local pool and usage record, then load the file. Continue?
settings.backupInvalid: This is not a valid HeavyScope backup JSON.
settings.backupApplied: Backup applied: {{pools}} pools upserted, {{inserted}} records added, {{skipped}} duplicates skipped.
settings.backupEmpty: Paste or import a backup JSON first.
settings.thresholdsHint: Usage bars turn amber at the warning percent and red at the critical percent.
settings.thresholdsInvalid: Warning must be at least 1 and strictly less than critical, which cannot exceed 100.
settings.poolsHint: Add, edit, or delete quota pools. The dashboard has the same actions.
settings.noPools: No pools yet. Add one here or from the dashboard.
settings.dataSourcesHint: Connect Cursor and Grok for live remaining quota, or import a snapshot. Manual entry stays the fallback when a connector fails.
settings.snapshotPlaceholder: Paste a Cursor snapshot JSON or pool,amount,note CSV…
settings.noSnapshot: Connect a Cursor session or import a snapshot before Cursor auto-sync can run.
settings.manualTruth: Manual entry remains the source of truth when adapters fail or a snapshot is stale.
settings.demoHint: Insert sample usage across the last 10 days for the four preset pools so charts and the advisor look alive. Notes are English. Existing records stay.
settings.demoConfirm: Add demo usage records to the four preset pools?
settings.demoConfirmAgain: Demo data was already loaded. Add another set of sample records?

common.dbErrorTitle: Could not open the local database
common.dbErrorBody: HeavyScope could not load the sql.js database. Your page is not blank — the error is shown here.
common.renderErrorBody: HeavyScope hit a render error. Reload the page to try again. Your local data is still in the browser.

advisor.title: Burn Rate Advisor
advisor.subtitle: Pace each pool so you neither waste leftover quota nor run out before reset.
advisor.switchSuggestion: {{from}} is running hot. Switch new work to {{to}} while it still has headroom.

charts.title: Usage trends
charts.subtitle: Daily activity heatmap plus a day / week / month stacked trend. Pool used% stays per pool so $ and % are never mixed.
charts.empty: No usage records yet. Record usage to see charts.
charts.modulesHint: Show or hide advisor, heatmap, and trend. Drag a module onto another to insert it before that target. Hidden modules stay in the saved order.
charts.heatmapHint: Intensity is daily record count, not amounts, so mixed-unit pools stay comparable.
charts.heatmapLegend: Hover a day for date and total.
charts.usageHint: Each bar is that pool's used percent. No shared pie across USD and percent pools.

history.title: Usage history
history.subtitle: Every recorded usage event, newest first.
history.dateHint: Date fields use the browser locale. HeavyScope does not override the picker.

tray.subtitle: Tightest pools this cycle
tray.empty: No pools yet. Add one in the web app.
tray.hideHint: Click outside or the menu-bar icon to hide.
